sections.label: Business adoption of data analytics
sections.summary: A Committee on the Future Economy study showed about a third of businesses have not adopted data analytics and about 80% have not adopted AI.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: A study done by the Committee on the Future Economy showed that about a third of businesses have not adopted data analytics and about 80% have not adopted AI.

sections.label: Poh Kim video analytics results
sections.summary: Video retailer Poh Kim deployed Ishikawa's video analytics solution to analyse customer traffic, optimise operations and improve marketing, increasing revenue by 10%.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Poh Kim, a video retailer, has deployed Ishikawa's video analytics solution to analyse its customer traffic, so as to optimise its operations and improve its marketing efforts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: These have helped Poh Kim to increase its revenue by 10%.

sections.label: Data Innovation Programme Office established
sections.summary: IMDA established the Data Innovation Programme Office on 1 April 2017 to champion this effort.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: IMDA established the Data Innovation Programme Office (DIPO) on 1 April 2017 to champion this effort.

sections.label: Regulatory sandbox for personal data
sections.summary: The Guide introduced a regulatory sandbox for personal data that exempts businesses from certain Personal Data Protection Act obligations under specific circumstances.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: The Guide also introduced a regulatory sandbox for personal data that exempts businesses from certain obligations under the Personal Data Protection Act under specific circumstances.

sections.label: SMEs Go Digital programme success
sections.summary: The SMEs Go Digital programme has by and large been quite successful.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: First, the SMEs Go Digital programme, by and large, has been quite successful.

sections.label: Off-the-shelf digital solutions for companies
sections.summary: After visiting a cleaning, security and construction company that were happy with the solution, IMDA wants to develop proven off-the-shelf digital solutions deployable and scalable to other companies.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: I have visited a cleaning company, a security company, a construction company and all of them are basically happy with the solution.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: So, what IMDA wants to do is to develop proven off-the-shelf digital solutions that can then be deployed and scaled to other companies.

sections.label: Subsidised digital programme and cost
sections.summary: The passage states cost remains a concern, the current programme is highly subsidised, and the Government must prove digitalisation is profitable for companies.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Cost will always remain a concern and that is why the current programme is highly subsidised.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: The real task of the Government is to prove to the companies that going digital is the way to go for them, not just to stay relevant, but to be profitable in time to come.
